title: Family Meeting
summary: Tunde, Ngozi and KC compare their records at the canteen. They make room for Nneka's private account, record custody without deciding ownership and choose how to investigate together.

stages.title: The bag arrived without a fare
stages.text:
Tunde: The bag entered my bus without paying.
Ngozi: At least one passenger is quiet.

Bring the unopened bag and its seat-location record to the table. The evidence journal is available above; it separates records from accounts still needing comparison. Restore earned records there if a saved source is missing.
stages.summary: Tunde brings the bag and its location record. The journal can recheck earned records without giving new rewards.

choices.label: Bring the bag and its record to the table

stages.title: Lunch has a filing system
stages.text:
Ngozi: Invoices on the dry side. Plates on the side that can survive KC.
KC: I have a very careful brand.
Ngozi: Then carefully wash your hands.

Bring invoice CAT-18. Keep the savings-circle sheet separate from the catering work and from the disputed bag.
stages.summary: Ngozi brings the catering invoice. Contribution records, catering work and bag custody are different matters.

choices.label: Set invoice CAT-18 beside the bag record

stages.title: One original. Several explanations.
stages.text:
KC: I brought the full source.
Tunde: Can it tell us who owns the trouble?
KC: It can tell us what my crop left outside.

Keep the full private source available for comparison. It is not a permission slip to broadcast the people in it.
stages.summary: KC brings the full private source. The family will compare it without treating possession as broadcast consent.

choices.label: Bring the private source without broadcasting it

stages.title: Start with where it was
stages.text:
Tunde: Beneath the seat. After the passengers left. Tag intact.
Ngozi: Good. A location is more useful than a theory with a loud voice.

Read the recorded observation without claiming it settles ownership or the whole wedding sequence.
stages.summary: Tunde recorded a bag beneath the bus seat with its exterior tag intact. That is a location observation, not the whole explanation.

choices.label: Keep the location and intact tag as the recorded observation
Treat finding the bag as proof that its contents are ours
choices.hint: The record establishes where it was found. Finding disputed property does not settle its ownership in this story.

stages.title: An unpaid invoice is still an invoice
stages.text:
Ngozi: Wedding catering. CAT-18. Balance outstanding.
KC: Chief's title uses more ink than the total.
Ngozi: Ink has never settled this account.

Keep the invoice as a record of catering work and its outstanding balance. Do not turn it into a claim that every part of the bag mystery is solved.
stages.summary: CAT-18 records catering work and an outstanding balance. Compare it with other sources rather than stretching its claim.

choices.label: Record its limited claim and compare the other sources
Say the invoice proves the entire bag sequence
choices.hint: The invoice supports the catering claim. The bag sequence still needs locations, timing and accounts compared.

stages.title: The bit outside the crop
stages.text:
KC: Here is the service exit. Here is the moment she turns to help Bisi.
Tunde: My bus still has no idea it is in a documentary.

Compare the private full-context copy with the wedding recording. Keep what it shows separate from guesses about what happened outside the frame.
stages.summary: The original shows the helping action omitted by the crop. It still does not show every part of the bag's journey.

records.title: Private source comparison
lines: Service exit and helping action remain visible

choices.label: Keep the full context and mark the remaining gaps
Hide the wider context because the crop is simpler
choices.hint: The wider context matters. Keep it and mark what the recording still cannot establish.

stages.title: Move the meeting, not the shouting
stages.text:
The generator rattles beyond the doorway. Its noise is described in the scene; no clue depends on hearing it.
KC: Can we turn up the truth?
Ngozi: We can move three chairs.

Choose a quieter place to talk without blocking the serving aisle.
stages.summary: Move to the quiet side of the canteen and keep the serving aisle clear.

choices.label: Move the chairs to the quiet side, with the aisle clear
Stay in the doorway and shout over everyone
choices.hint: Use the quiet side and leave the serving aisle clear. The conversation does not need a louder audience.

stages.title: Let me finish telling you
stages.text:
Nneka arrives voluntarily.
Nneka: Before you decide what I did, let me finish telling you. No camera, please.
Ngozi: You have a chair. You do not owe the queue a performance.

Hear the initial account privately and arrange its follow-up. The journal keeps it as an account to verify; it is not yet the later corroborated testimony.
stages.summary: Respect the requested private conversation and arrange follow-up. Keep the account distinct from corroborated evidence.

choices.label: Listen privately and arrange the follow-up
Ask KC to broadcast the arrival
choices.hint: Nneka requested no camera. The private follow-up keeps the investigation moving without a broadcast.

admit.text:
Ngozi: You told me the earlier crop left out the helping action. Thank you for bringing the full source.
KC: My apology has better framing now.
admit.summary: KC already disclosed the omission. The discussion can clarify details without erasing that admission.

defer.text:
Ngozi: You said you still needed to check the cut. This is a place to explain it.
KC: A very well-lit place for a difficult sentence.
defer.summary: The earlier conversation is unresolved. KC can explain the omitted context now or leave the follow-up open.

stages.title: A correction can sit at the table
stages.text: Explain the omitted context now, or keep checking details. Either continues. A later check does not erase an earlier admission; an unresolved conversation remains visible in the journal and can be addressed later.
stages.summary: Explain the cut now or retain the open follow-up. Existing admissions stay recorded and no main mission is lost.

choices.label: Explain clearly that the earlier crop omitted the helping action
Keep checking details and leave any unresolved follow-up open

stages.title: A place for the bag and the record
stages.text:
Tunde: Nobody spends a passenger we have not identified.
Ngozi: It is a bag.
Tunde: It has made more demands than most passengers.

Record temporary custody with the intact tag and source list. Either arrangement preserves the records and does not decide ownership or an ending.
stages.summary: Choose recorded temporary custody with Ngozi or a jointly witnessed record. Neither spends the contents or decides ownership.

records.title: Temporary custody sheet
lines: Catering invoice and private source listed separately

choices.label: Record Ngozi holding the intact bag with the source list
Make a joint witnessed custody record
Split the contents before anyone asks
choices.hint: Choose a recorded custody arrangement. This checkpoint preserves disputed property; it is not a currency reward.

stages.title: Does the theory have a receipt?
stages.text:
KC: I have a theory.
Ngozi: Does it have a receipt?
Tunde: Mine has a transport fare.

Choose how the group intends to investigate. Protecting people prioritises private checks; building a public case prioritises a verified presentation. Both require consent before using a person's account publicly. Both keep all main missions, evidence and endings available.
stages.summary: Choose private-first protection or a verified public case. Both retain consent requirements, all missions and all evidence.

choices.label: Protect people and verify the story privately first
Build a public case from verified records and consent

protect.text:
Ngozi: We check with people before we make them a story.
KC: Can the agreement have a title?
Tunde: After you wash your plate.
protect.summary: The group agreed to private-first verification while preserving all records and future choices.

public_case.text:
KC: A public case. With sources.
Ngozi: And permission. Those words belong in the same sentence.
Tunde: Put the washing-up in the next sentence.
public_case.summary: The group agreed to a verified public case while preserving consent, records and future choices.

stages.title: Three people. One table.
stages.text: The source records, temporary custody, disclosure and pact are saved. Use the evidence journal to review their roles and the open questions. Between chapters, choose Tunde, Ngozi or KC at this table. Generator Wars is the next main chapter.
stages.summary: Family Meeting records the shared investigation, custody and pact. Each lead gains one mastery once. The journal retains the sources and unresolved questions; Generator Wars follows.

choices.label: Save the meeting record
